deathSays.line: A tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price; the claws are trade and talisman both. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"

🔥 The fire settles. Ava has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nino breathes "And you're still standing." Joseph says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
That night, they bring Wilhelm home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

tableLines.line: ⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. James speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🖐️ Its hands blur — and suddenly it's holding your Crowbar! It's already running.
Colton wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what Ella said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"

Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
A kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
